senses.gloss: ṛlla, m. (cf. next), something like prize-fighter: naṭanartaka-ṛlla-malla- etc. Mv 〔i.231.12〕, and in similar cpds. Mv 〔i.259.5〕; 〔ii.100.10〕; 〔150.4〕; 〔153.17〕; 〔156.9〕; 〔iii.57.9〕; 〔113.3〕; 〔141.17〕; 〔161.3〕; 〔255.11〕; 〔266.5〕; 〔442.9〕. Senart on 〔i.231.12〕, note, was inclined to think the word a graphic error for jhalla, as was Burnouf (see next); but he kept the mss. reading, which seems too common to emend.

ṛllaka, m., = preceding: SP 〔480.9〕 (prose) na ṛllakā, all mss. that contain the word (ed. narllakā); in SP 〔280.6〕 Burnouf (〔fol. 150 b〕) says all his 3 mss. read ṛllakebhir, which KN report for only one ms. (their text jhall˚).
